rows.en: Leave it to us! Now, let's move on ahead!

...Hey, boss. Ain't you letting them push in a little too far?
Heh. I saw this coming. I've already taken measures.
Ohh... So you've got it all figured out, huh? So? You've got a part lined up for me, right?
Of course, Arche Gundam. The decisive battle will be in the deepest part.
The deepest part? Why go all the way down there...
We Innovators fight at an advantage the closer we are to Veda.
Also, the denser the GN particles, the better.
Huh...
This is... a control room. It looks a lot like the one on the Middle Layer.

That's highly likely... The deepest part, huh? We've got no time to dawdle. Let's go.
What are these particles...
GN particles... and at a very high density.
The huge space is just ahead. Let's hurry.
...Lost Heroes! I won't let you through here!!

notes.note: Continues the 0651 leader-variant block from story_132 (0.109-0.122). The script's leader branching here is not fully recoverable (only Wing Zero +108 and a Mebius-named +116 are explicit), so lines are voiced from wording. 0.115/0.116 match story_132's 0.114 exactly (identical source). 'Makasete oke' answers Duo's 'I'm counting on you to destroy it' -> 'Leave it to us'.
Labelled Mebius; polite. Honorific on Ankh dropped.
Labelled Mebius by the extractor, but the casual 'makasete oke tte' does not fit Mebius; likely another leader (Zero-like). Voiced casual.
Rough '-nee' speech (Momotaros or Zero style); label 'Mebius' looks like a carry-over from the script trace.
Labelled Reborns, same as 0.1: Ribbons dismissing the heroes' success. Subject 'they' (the heroes) restored.
Ali calls Ribbons 'taishou' -> 'boss' (story_099 already has him calling his employer 'the boss'). 'Semekomaresugi' (being pushed in on too far) rendered as Reborns' side letting the heroes push in.
'Chuusou' -> 'Middle Layer', matching earlier slices for this Cube.

Leader blocks 0.2-0.16, 0.20-0.34, 0.36-0.50 follow 0653.bla's second Pt_Chara_Check order: Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O Sword, W, OOO. Confirmed by voice: -ze ending at slot 10 (Zero), rough -nee at slot 13 (Momotaros), polite -masu at slot 9 (Mebius). '-miyou' -> 'Let's try scanning'; the '-miru ka' variants (God, Wing Zero, 00) -> 'Let's give it a scan'.
Double ellipsis written as a single '...', matching story_132 0651#0.90.
Ankh asking the leader; subject 'you' restored.
'Saishinbu' rendered 'the deepest part' throughout, as in earlier slices ('deepest part of this Cube').
Ankh's 'isogu zo' rendered 'Let's hurry' (he is moving with the team).

Leader block 0.2-0.16 (ends in story_134) follows 0655.bla's second Pt_Chara_Check order: 00, Wing Zero, God, Nu, Zeta, Zero, Mebius, OOO, W, Den-O Sword, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, Black RX, Rider 1. Matches voice (Setsuna 'eliminate', Heero 'weaklings', Mebius 'bokutachi'). The heroes address Tieren Taozi in the plural (omae-tachi), kept as plural 'you'.
Subject not stated; 'I' for Heero/Domon (0.3/0.4), 'we' where the speaker is a team player (Amuro). Kept the source's choice of 'kocchi' / 'bokutachi' as 'we' in 0.7/0.8.
Kamille: 'detekonakereba taosareru koto mo nai' = if you hadn't come out, you wouldn't be beaten; rendered as a warning to stand down.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader orders taken from the event scripts (0653, 0655) and confirmed by voice. 0651 #0.115-0.122 voiced from wording only: extractor labels Mebius on #0.118/#0.121 look wrong. No new names or terms.
